cross_clock.condition: Projection assumes offsets between endpoint calibrations remain inside the envelope of all observed RTT bounds. Intervening drift is unproven.

header.limits: Polling may miss short-lived tasks. Runtime is cumulative; runqueue wait requires enabled scheduler stats. No QEMU affinity or kernel setting is changed.

limits: Polling can miss entire short-lived tasks and CPU use after their last sample.
Overlapping-interval totals are observed deltas, not global upper bounds.
Birth-to-first-sample CPU and final-to-exit CPU are excluded from interval deltas.
Only QEMU threads were sampled; other host tasks and all sources of interference were not measured. Presence, runtime or correlation does not prove causation.
No task-count/placement admission check is waived by this report.
Observer overhead and clock-bracket instrumentation distinguish this collection from the original matrix and plain replay; do not pool their timings.
